title: The Clever Rabbit
text:
Long ago, a small rabbit lived near a big lake. She was very fast. Every morning she ran to the lake to drink water.

One day, a big bear said, 'I am faster than you!' The rabbit smiled and said, 'Let us run to the tree and see.' The rabbit won the race because she was clever.

questions.text: Which animal said, 'I am faster than you!'?

options: She was sure she would win.

questions.text: What kind of character is the rabbit?

vocabulary.definition: a small animal with long ears that hops
a large area of water surrounded by land
able to learn and think quickly
a contest to see who is fastest

paragraph_translations: Há muito tempo, um pequeno coelho morava perto de um grande lago. Ela era muito rápida. Todas as manhãs corria até o lago para beber água.
Um dia, um urso grande disse: 'Eu sou mais rápido que você!' O coelho sorriu e disse: 'Vamos correr até a árvore e ver.' O coelho ganhou a corrida porque era esperto.
